limitations: Visual coverage and findings describe images only. Separate audio correspondences locate sound; neither establishes speaker intent.
Repeated/static scenes may be rejected as ambiguous.
Cropping, overlays, speed changes and large color changes are not reliably supported.
Omissions require a supported cut or aligned boundary; unresolved source ranges are not labeled omitted. An edit alone does not establish misleading intent.
Matching sound does not establish matching images or speaker intent.
Silence and repeated sound are rejected; dubbing, music replacement and speed changes may remain unresolved.

prediction.limitations: Matched media deletion only; material effect on meaning remains unassessed. Boundary trims are not internal omissions. No match is an abstention, not proof of a faithful edit.
